content:
Error

This error occurs when Manager cannot open or access a business database file.

There are several possible reasons why you might see this error:

• The business database file has been moved, renamed, or deleted

• You do not have the necessary permissions to access the file

• The database file is corrupted or in an incompatible format

• The business ID in the URL is incorrect

What to do

If you see this error, try the following steps:

1. Verify that the business database file exists in the correct location

2. Check that you have read/write permissions for the file

3. Return to the main Businesses screen and try opening the business again

4. If the problem persists, the database file may need to be restored from a backup
